valuation_template_rationale: Coinbase combines cyclical transaction, stablecoin, staking, custody, financing, derivatives and crypto-asset economics, so no specialized repository template captures the distinct revenue drivers and balance-sheet exposures.
bear_assumptions: USD 2.0 billion transaction revenue at 2x plus USD 2.0 billion recurring revenue at 4x, less a USD 4.0 billion net balance-sheet deduction over 282 million diluted shares; volumes, rates and take rates stay weak and dilution persists.
base_assumptions: USD 2.7 billion transaction revenue at 4x plus USD 2.4 billion recurring revenue at 7x, less a USD 3.0 billion net balance-sheet deduction over 282 million diluted shares; Deribit supports institutional mix, but crypto-cycle and counterparty concentration remain.
bull_assumptions: USD 4.0 billion transaction revenue at 6x plus USD 3.2 billion recurring revenue at 10x, less a USD 2.0 billion net balance-sheet deduction over 282 million diluted shares; volumes recover, stablecoin balances offset lower rates, margins improve and dilution moderates.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower price or stronger primary evidence on cycle-normalized volumes, take rates, stablecoin economics, recurring revenue, corporate cash, debt and diluted per-share cash generation clears expected-return, base-return, downside-payoff and margin-of-safety gates; downgrade the operating thesis if assets, users, share, counterparty economics, custody controls, regulation or dilution-adjusted cash generation deteriorates.
